entries.notes: index.tsx boots asynchronously: in SaaS mode it registers the getsentry overrides, loads the /api/client-config/ payload (window.__initialData, captured from the live page) into ConfigStore and then calls renderDom(Main), so the static side runs the same bootstrap before rendering the exported Main component. entries.description: Plane web app sign-in page (React Router framework mode with ssr: false, pnpm + Turborepo monorepo, Django API from the repository's Docker development stack)
entries.notes: `plane-services.sh` copies the three `.env.example` files and brings up `docker-compose-local.yml` (PostgreSQL, Valkey, RabbitMQ, MinIO, migrator, API on :8000) with `plane-compose.override.yml`, which unpublishes the database/cache host ports so they cannot collide with the other corpus containers. `turbo run dev --filter=web` builds the workspace packages first (they export `dist/`), then runs `react-router dev --port 3000`. `plane-setup.sh` symlinks `@tailwindcss/postcss` (a dependency of `packages/tailwind-config` only) into `apps/web/node_modules` because `apps/web/postcss.config.js` re-exports the shared config and postcss-load-config resolves plugin names from `apps/web`. Run with `--corpus-dir` outside this monorepo: `@react-router/dev` pre-bundles `react-router-dom` whenever `require.resolve` finds one from the app root, and a checkout nested under bippy picks up bippy's unrelated `react-router-dom@6`, which fails esbuild's optimizer against `react-router@7`.

entries.description: next-forge marketing site apps/web (Next 16 app router, Turborepo + Bun workspaces, Clerk keyless, t3-env)
entries.notes: Static-only: `app/[locale]/layout.tsx` renders `Toolbar` from `basehub/next-toolbar`, whose `getStuffFromEnv` throws `Token not found` without `BASEHUB_TOKEN` and `Failed to resolve ref: Unauthorized` with a placeholder `bshb_pk_*` token (it resolves the ref against api.basehub.com), so every `/en` request answers 500 without real BaseHub credentials. The other keys in `apps/web/.env.example` are optional, but its empty strings fail the `z.url().optional()` schemas, so `.env.local` keeps only the non-empty lines. The marketing home lives under `app/[locale]/(home)`; the bare `/` answers 404 in this setup instead of being rewritten by the next-international proxy.

entries.install: pnpm install && pnpm --filter @mcansh/remix-fastify build && pnpm add "react-router-dom@$(node -p "require('react-router/package.json').version")"
entries.notes: The harness clones into the bippy monorepo, whose hoisted node_modules holds react-router-dom@6 for an e2e fixture; `@react-router/dev` pre-bundles `react-router-dom` whenever `require.resolve` finds one, and rolldown-vite (vite 8) fails the dependency optimizer on the v6 package's missing exports. Installing a matching react-router-dom@7 in the app shadows the hoisted copy; nothing else is patched.

entries.description: OpenAI Translator PWA (Vite 6 with root=src, React 19 + React Compiler, react-router-dom 7 nested routes with lazy pages, react-daisyui, zustand, @tanstack/react-query, react-i18next over HTTP backend with suspense)
entries.notes: vite.config.ts sets `root: src` (index.html lives in src/), aliases `@/` to src/ (mirrored by tsconfig paths) and defines BUILD_TIME as `new Date().toISOString()` at dev-server start, which the Header prints as text; that timestamp differs per run so it stays unbound (one text wildcard) rather than a guessed define. No .env files exist so VITE_PUBLIC_PATH is unset and base stays `/`. Translations load from src/public/locales through i18next-http-backend with `useSuspense: true`.

entries.description: Kent C. Dodds' Bookshelf workshop app, unauthenticated screen (CRA 5 / webpack, React 18, Emotion 10 `@jsx jsx` pragma with css props, react-query 2, Reach UI, MSW mock API in a service worker)
entries.notes: CRA loads `.env.development` over `.env` and inlines `REACT_APP_*`; `jsconfig.json` sets `baseUrl: ./src`. The dev tools install a second React root, so the app root is anchored on `AppProviders`. Without a stored auth token `bootstrapAppData` resolves to no user without hitting the mock API, so the unauthenticated screen is captured.

entries.description: JSON Crack landing page (Next 16 pages router on webpack, pnpm + turbo monorepo, React 19, Mantine 8, styled-components 6, next-seo, zustand 5)
entries.notes: `engines.node >= 24` and `packageManager: pnpm@10.20.0`, so install/dev run through the Node wrapper. `turbo run dev` builds the `jsoncrack-react` workspace package first (`_app.tsx` imports its dist stylesheet), which the setup step reproduces; `next dev --webpack` then serves apps/www. Next loads `.env.development` over `.env` and inlines `NEXT_PUBLIC_*`. `pages/index.tsx` exports `getStaticProps` (GitHub star count fetched at build time), so `pageProps` is unknown to the static side.

entries.description: Redash client (React 16 on antd + react-router-less custom routing, webpack dev server without the Flask backend)
entries.notes: Static-only: react-doctor scanned viz-lib, a visualization library; the runnable app is the client/ webpack app at the repository root, which depends on it as @redash/viz (built by the setup step). Without the Flask backend (Postgres + Redis + `redash create_db`) the session request fails and the client hard-navigates to the server-rendered /login?next=/ page, which the dev server proxies to the missing backend (504), so no React commit is observable.

entries.description: ToolJet frontend login page (React 18 SPA on react-router v6 + zustand, webpack dev server)
entries.notes: Static-only: src/index.jsx only calls render() after appService.getConfig() (GET /api/config, proxied to the NestJS server on localhost:3000) resolves, so without the server, its Postgres database and migrations no React commit ever happens (the page stays on the static 'Loading...' shell). The frontend also imports @tooljet/plugins/client, a generated entry over the checked-in plugin manifests; the setup step installs the plugins workspace and generates that entry so the webpack dev server compiles.
